caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic pitcher positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The pitcher has a rounded body, a small footed base, a curved handle on the right, and a short spout on the left. The body of the pitcher is primarily white with decorative elements in brown and shades of pink. The decoration consists of segmented sections outlined in brown, with floral motifs; there are pink flowers with dark pink centers and brown leaves and stems. A brown line runs along the rim and the top of the handle, and another brown line encircles the base above the foot. The composition is minimal, with all attention focused on the pitcher, and there are no other objects present in the image.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
